objective: Find the molecular mechanism that best explains the loss of function of BTK-p.Arg28His (BTK, UniProt Q06187) and test it with one targeted computational test.

Confirms H1 if His28 keeps the contact count and buried area of Arg28 within noise. Overturns H1 if His28 loses the phosphate contacts, which meets H1's own would_refute criterion.
